Not much at all! Just a lighter or matches to light them, and a heat-safe surface or holder.
For tea lights, they come in their own metal or clear cups, so you just place them on a coaster, dish, or tea light holder. If you move on to votives, pillars, or tapers down the road, keeping a simple wick trimmer handy helps keep wicks at 1/4 inch for the cleanest burn.
